'''Pilba Dalohog''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Em'liy/Legends|Em'liy]] who chose to travel off [[Shalyvane]] after its [[Cleansing of Shalyvane|devastation]], making him one of the few Em'liy to do so.

Despite the loneliness and prejudice he experienced, he hoped other members of his race would eventually follow his lead.
